title: Problem
问题
html:
GDPval evaluates economically valuable one-shot professional deliverables with expert blind comparisons and an experimental public grader. The primary sources are OpenAI GDPval publication, arXiv 2510.04374, and evals.openai.com/gdpval.

The concrete problem is whether AI systems can produce real-world professional deliverables that match or beat human expert work across economically important occupations. The decision boundary is one-shot deliverable evaluation, not a full interactive agent-environment trajectory dataset.

The data object or evaluation surface is 1,320 full-set tasks across 44 occupations and 9 U.S. GDP sectors, with 220 open-sourced gold tasks, reference files, and deliverables such as documents, slides, diagrams, spreadsheets, and multimedia. This is useful for the atlas because it makes the feedback contract explicit: expert blind pairwise comparison of AI and human deliverables; the public automated grader is experimental.

GDPval 用专家盲评和实验性公开评分服务评测经济价值专业交付物。 主来源是OpenAI GDPval 官方发布、arXiv 2510.04374 和 evals.openai.com/gdpval。

它回答的具体问题是：AI 系统能否在经济重要职业中产出达到或超过人类专家工作的专业交付物。决策边界是一轮专业交付物评测，不是完整交互式 agent-environment 轨迹数据集。

数据对象或评测面是1,320 个完整任务，覆盖 44 个职业和 9 个美国 GDP 部门；其中 220 个公开 gold tasks，包含参考文件和文档、幻灯片、图表、表格、多媒体等交付物。它对 atlas 的价值在于把反馈契约说清楚：专家对 AI 与人类交付物做盲评比较；公开自动 grader 是实验性服务。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is a professional-work benchmark that moves evaluation from short answers to realistic deliverables.

The core mechanism is occupation sampling, task specification, reference materials, human deliverables, model deliverables, expert comparison, and optional public grading service. The object being scored is 1,320 full-set tasks across 44 occupations and 9 U.S. GDP sectors, with 220 open-sourced gold tasks, reference files, and deliverables such as documents, slides, diagrams, spreadsheets, and multimedia, and the feedback contract is expert blind pairwise comparison of AI and human deliverables; the public automated grader is experimental.

The closest comparisons are static QA benchmarks, office automation tasks, and agent benchmarks that lack expert deliverable comparison at this scale. Its direction label is evaluation-surface and feedback-contract curation rather than generic dataset summarization.

一句话贡献是：把评测对象从短答案推进到真实专业交付物的 professional-work benchmark。

核心机制是职业采样、任务说明、参考材料、人类交付物、模型交付物、专家比较，以及可选公开评分服务。被评分对象是1,320 个完整任务，覆盖 44 个职业和 9 个美国 GDP 部门；其中 220 个公开 gold tasks，包含参考文件和文档、幻灯片、图表、表格、多媒体等交付物，反馈契约是专家对 AI 与人类交付物做盲评比较；公开自动 grader 是实验性服务。

最近对比对象是静态 QA benchmark、办公自动化任务和缺少这种规模专家交付物比较的 agent benchmark。方向标签是 evaluation surface 与 feedback contract curation，而不是泛泛数据集摘要。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are the task materials and metadata needed to form one record: 1,320 full-set tasks across 44 occupations and 9 U.S. GDP sectors, with 220 open-sourced gold tasks, reference files, and deliverables such as documents, slides, diagrams, spreadsheets, and multimedia.

Pipeline: Select economically relevant occupations and tasks; package reference files and deliverable requirements; collect human and model outputs; ask domain experts to compare outputs blindly; expose a public subset and grader for reproducibility experiments.

Outputs are scored benchmark records or evaluation summaries under this contract: expert blind pairwise comparison of AI and human deliverables; the public automated grader is experimental. Reuse must pin source version, split, scorer or judge version, prompt/scaffold policy, runtime environment where relevant, and artifact license.

输入是一条记录所需的任务材料和元数据：1,320 个完整任务，覆盖 44 个职业和 9 个美国 GDP 部门；其中 220 个公开 gold tasks，包含参考文件和文档、幻灯片、图表、表格、多媒体等交付物。

流程：选择经济相关职业和任务；打包参考文件与交付要求；收集人类和模型输出；由领域专家盲评比较；公开子集和 grader 用于复现实验。

输出是在该契约下评分的 benchmark record 或 evaluation summary：专家对 AI 与人类交付物做盲评比较；公开自动 grader 是实验性服务。复用必须固定来源版本、split、scorer 或 judge 版本、prompt/scaffold policy、相关运行环境和 artifact license。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Official sources report 1,320 tasks, 44 occupations, 9 sectors, and 220 public gold tasks. The strongest evidence is expert comparison of finished deliverables; automated grader scores are useful but should not replace expert judgments.

The important audit point is the level at which evidence attaches. A benchmark score, judge score, or leaderboard metric is not automatically a row-level verifier certificate unless the source exposes such a verifier.

Score reuse should keep the evaluated split, scorer, model/scaffold settings, and artifact version together with the reported number.

官方来源报告 1,320 个任务、44 个职业、9 个部门和 220 个公开 gold tasks。最强证据是专家对最终交付物的比较；自动 grader 分数有用，但不能替代专家判断。

审计重点是证据附着在哪个层级。benchmark score、judge score 或 leaderboard metric 不会自动变成行级 verifier certificate，除非来源明确公开了这样的 verifier。

复用分数时，应把 evaluated split、scorer、模型/scaffold 设置和 artifact version 与数字一起保存。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior work to compare against includes static QA benchmarks, office automation tasks, and agent benchmarks that lack expert deliverable comparison at this scale.

The new object is a professional deliverable with files, format expectations, and expert comparison, rather than a short-answer item.

What is not new: Human evaluation and workplace tasks are not new; reuse must pin public versus held-out tasks, grader version, expert rubric, and license/access terms.

已有工作主要包括静态 QA benchmark、办公自动化任务和缺少这种规模专家交付物比较的 agent benchmark。

新的对象是带文件、格式要求和专家比较的专业交付物，而不是短答案条目。

不新之处：人类评测和工作任务不新；复用要固定公开/保留任务、grader 版本、专家 rubric 和许可/访问条款。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Scores depend on expert pool, rubric, deliverable format, hidden-set access, model tool stack, and grader drift.

The result should not be read beyond the disclosed source, split, scorer, judge, runtime, or artifact policy. Public releases can also become future training contamination.

If the benchmark signal is reused for training, filtering, or reward design, the feedback contract needs a separate audit from the headline score.

分数依赖专家池、rubric、交付物格式、hidden set 访问、模型工具栈和 grader 漂移。

结论不能超出已披露的来源、split、scorer、judge、runtime 或 artifact policy。公开 release 也可能成为后续模型训练污染。

如果把 benchmark 信号复用到训练、过滤或 reward 设计中，反馈契约需要独立于 headline score 再审一遍。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use it as a schema for professional-work evaluation: task, occupation, sector, files, deliverable type, human reference, model output, expert comparison, grader version, and split.

For the atlas, this card is useful because it names the reusable object, the scorer or judge, and the provenance fields that must travel with any downstream score.

A derived recipe should preserve task provenance, split, scorer, judge or verifier version, and any hidden/public boundary.

可作为 professional-work evaluation schema：任务、职业、部门、文件、交付物类型、人类参考、模型输出、专家比较、grader 版本和 split。

对 atlas 来说，这张卡有用，因为它命名了可复用对象、scorer 或 judge，以及任何下游分数必须携带的 provenance 字段。

派生 recipe 应保留任务来源、split、scorer、judge 或 verifier 版本，以及 hidden/public 边界。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Do not read GDPval as state-action trajectory data. The primary evidence is output-level expert comparison of deliverables.

Read the source sections that define the data object and scorer before reading aggregate results. The most common mistake is to copy a headline score without the split, evaluator, and scaffold assumptions that make the score meaningful.

不要把 GDPval 读成 state-action 轨迹数据。它的主要证据是交付物层面的专家比较。

先读定义数据对象和 scorer 的来源章节，再读聚合结果。最常见错误是只搬运 headline score，却丢掉 split、evaluator 和 scaffold 假设。
